# Local NPC Chat RPG
> An experimental static web app (v0.2.0-build.001): chat with four original town residents, powered by a small language model (LFM2.5 350M or 1.2B-JP, selectable) that runs locally in the browser via WebGPU. No server, no API key; conversations stay on the device.
URL: https://egoaid.github.io/Local-NPC-Chat/
